tei:div.tei:p: "$ (71)༄༅// byin rlabs nye brgyud kyi gsol 'debs dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// mkhyen pas srid pa'i 'ching ba mthar mdzad cing*// thugs rjes zhi la dga' ba ring du dor// srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas srid zhi'i mgon// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams zhing gi rdul snyed las 'das pa'i// grangs med rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i gter// mtha' yas gcig tu bsdus pa'i ye shes sku// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la= /rlabs chen smon lam ring nas btab pa'i mthus// rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du// the tshom drwa ba mtha' dag bsal gyur pa// dpa' bo rdo rje'i zhabs la= /bden gnyis gnas tshul rig pas legs rtogs shing*// thabs shes zung 'brel nyams su blangs pa'i mthus// sku gsum mngon du gyur ba'i tsong kha pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la= /rgyal tshab rje dang mkhas grub dge legs dpal// shes rab seng ge dge 'dun grub pa sogs// smra ba'i dbang bo rim par byon pa yi// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la= /rab 'byams gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig /skal bzang thar bar bsgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog /brtse bas bskyangs pa'i thabs mkhas mdzad pa yis// gsal mdzad bshes gnyen rnams la= /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kyi// yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba drin can rje// yid la dran pa tsam gyis dus kun tu// mos gus rtsol med skye bar byin gyis rlobs// 'dod chung chog shes zhi zhing dul bar gnas// snying nas thar pa don gnyer gsong por smra// bag yod la sbyor grogs mchog bsten byed cing*// dag snang phyogs med skye bar// 'chi ba nges shing nam 'chi cha med pa// tshig tsam min pa dran nas long med dang*// rnyed bkur chos la gting nas zhen (72)log ste// dgos med rgyud la skye// lus can mtha' dag drin can mar shes pas// nyam thag rnams kyi sdug bsngal dran gyur nas// rang bde 'ba' zhig sgrub las yid log ste// snying rje rtsol med skye bar// mthar 'dzin nad kun sel ba'i sman gcig pu// zab mo rten 'brel mtha' dang bral ba'i don// 'phags mchog klu sgrub yab sras dgongs pa dag

/ji bzhin khong du chud par= dge 'dis mtshon nas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i// bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa// de dag thams cad skye zhing skye ba ru// byang chub mchog gi rjes su mi mthun pa'i// shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang grags pa dang*// 'khor dang longs spyod rnyed dang bkur sti'i rgyur// skad cig tsam yang nam yang mi smin par// bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur gyur cig /rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang*// rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis// rnam dag smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par shog /ces byin rlabs nye brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub kyi snye ma zhes bya ba 'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis gdangs can khrod kyi gangs ri'i dbang bo'i de gung rgyal gyi lha zhol du sbyar ba'o// dge'o/// /
